system.description:
A device that magnifies images of distant objects, allowing the user to pick out details more easily. Higher tech level versions incorporate additional functions, such as a rangefinder to provide an accurate distance to the target, as well as night vision and thermal imaging for finding targets in dark or obscured conditions.

Using binoculars reduces the Difficulty of Skill Tests by 1 when observing or studying details of distant objects, creatures, or places. A Tech Level 3 set of binoculars also allows the user to ignore Difficulty increases from darkness, smoke, dust clouds, and similar obscuring factors.
